body: Where did the transport get to overnight?
PTY delivery is landing. I buffered writes to the turn boundary so a message no longer arrives mid-token.
One case still fails: an interrupt arrives before a queued normal message. I need your ordering before I change it.

Good. Keep the queue depth bounded and tell me the number.
Bounded at 64 envelopes per session. Beyond that the sender gets a typed rejection rather than silent loss.
Second run on the teardown task ended the same way. The PTY handle is still open after retire.
I have stopped. This needs someone with the runtime context.
Ranking decisions above blocked work. A blocked task can wait; a decision is holding an agent still.
Agreed. And only one gold at a time. I do not want a lit-up screen.
Counted it across all six rooms with seven live items. One gold per frame, every frame.
